source(output(
		PaymentDate as string,
		GenderCode as string,
		AgeGroup as string,
		StateCountyCode as string,
		Hospice as string,
		ESRD as string,
		Inst as string,
		RiskAdjFacPrtA as string,
		RiskAdjFacPrtB as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA as string,
		AdjReasonCode as string,
		PayAdjStartDate as string,
		PayAdjEndDate as string,
		PrtDRAFac as string,
		PrtDLowIncomeInd as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		ContractNumber as string,
		RunDate as timestamp,
		HICN as string,
		Surname as string,
		FirstInitial as string,
		DateofBirth as date,
		OutofAreaInd as string,
		PrtAEntitlement as string,
		PrtBEntitlement as string,
		AgedDisabledMSP as string,
		NHC as string,
		NewMedicaidStsflag as string,
		LTIFlag as string,
		MedicaidInd as string,
		PIP_DCG as string,
		DefaultRiskFacCode as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB as string,
		DemPayAdjRatePrtA as string,
		DemPayAdjRatePrtB as string,
		MonPayAdjAmtRateA as string,
		MonPayAdjAmtRateB as string,
		LISPremSubsidy as string,
		ESRDMSPFlag as string,
		MTM as string,
		Filler as string,
		MedicaidSts as string,
		RiskAdjAgeGroup as string,
		PreviousDisableRatio as string,
		DeMinimis as string,
		DualPrtDEnrollSts as string,
		PBP as string,
		RaceCode as string,
		RiskAdjFacTypeCode as string,
		FrailtyInd as string,
		OREC as string,
		LagInd as string,
		SegmentNumber as string,
		EnrollmentSource as string,
		EGHPFlag as string,
		PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt as string,
		PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt as string,
		RbtPrtACostSharReduc as string,
		RbtPrtBCostSharReduc as string,
		RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits as string,
		RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits as string,
		RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt as string,
		RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt as string,
		RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt as string,
		RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt as string,
		TotalPrtAMAPymt as string,
		TotalPrtBMAPymt as string,
		TotalMAPayAmt as string,
		PrtDLowIncomeMul as string,
		PrtDLongTermInstInd as string,
		PrtDLongTermInstMul as string,
		RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc as string,
		PrtDBasicPremAmt as string,
		PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt as string,
		ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt as string,
		LICSSubsidyAmt as string,
		TotalPrtDPymt as string,
		PACEPremAddOn as string,
		PACECostSharingAddon as string,
		PrtCFrailtyScoreFac as string,
		MSPFac as string,
		MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA as string,
		MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB as string,
		MedicaidDualStsCode as string,
		PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt as string,
		PrtDRiskAdjtFacType as string,
		DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode as string,
		PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt as string,
		PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt as string,
		PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt as string,
		CleanupID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  MMRRAW.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR AS ContractNumber, MMRRAW.CMS_RUN_DT AS RunDate, MMRRAW.PAYMENT_DT AS PaymentDate, MMRRAW.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AS HICN, MMRRAW.LAST_NM AS Surname, MMRRAW.FRST_INIT_NM AS FirstInitial, MMRRAW.SRC_MBR_GNDR_CD AS GenderCode, MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT AS DateofBirth, CASE  WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 THEN \'01-64\' WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 65 AND 69 THEN \'65-69\' WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 70 AND 74 THEN \'70-74\' WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 75 AND 79 THEN \'75-79\' WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 80 AND 84 THEN \'80-84\' WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(hour,MMRRAW.MBR_BRTH_DT,GETDATE())/8766 AS INTEGER) >= 85 THEN \'85+\' END AS AgeGroup, MMRRAW.STATE_COUNTRY_CD AS StateCountyCode, MMRRAW.OUT_OF_AREA_IND AS OutofAreaInd, MMRRAW.PART_A_ENTITLEMENT AS PrtAEntitlement, MMRRAW.PART_B_ENTITLEMENT AS PrtBEntitlement, MMRRAW.HOSPICE AS Hospice, MMRRAW.ESRD AS ESRD, MMRRAW.MSP_AGED_DISABLED AS AgedDisabledMSP, MMRRAW.INSTITUTIONAL AS Inst, MMRRAW.NHC AS NHC, MMRRAW.MEDICAID_STS_NEW_BENIF AS NewMedicaidStsflag, MMRRAW.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_PART_C AS LTIFlag, MMRRAW.MEDICAID_ADD_ON_FAC AS MedicaidInd, MMRRAW.PIP_DCG AS PIP_DCG, MMRRAW.DEF_RISK_FAC_CD_PART_C AS DefaultRiskFacCode, MMRRAW.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_A AS RiskAdjFacPrtA, MMRRAW.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_B AS RiskAdjFacPrtB, MMRRAW.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_PART_A AS NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA, MMRRAW.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_PART_B AS NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB, MMRRAW.ADJ_REASON_CD AS AdjReasonCode,  CONVERT (varchar(10), MMRRAW.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT, 101) AS PayAdjStartDate,  CONVERT (varchar(10), MMRRAW.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT , 101)  AS PayAdjEndDate, MMRRAW.DEMOG_PAY_ADJ_PART_A AS DemPayAdjRatePrtA, MMRRAW.DEMOG_PAY_ADJ_PART_B AS DemPayAdjRatePrtB, MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_A AS MonPayAdjAmtRateA,  MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_AMT_PART_B AS MonPayAdjAmtRateB, MMRRAW.ORIG_LOW_INCM_PREM_SBSDY_AMT AS LISPremSubsidy, MMRRAW.MSP_ESRD AS ESRDMSPFlag, MMRRAW.MTM_AMT AS MTM, MMRRAW.Filler1 AS Filler, MMRRAW.MEDICAID_STS AS MedicaidSts, MMRRAW.RAAG AS RiskAdjAgeGroup, MMRRAW.PRDIB AS PreviousDisableRatio, MMRRAW.DE_MINIMIS_PART_D AS DeMinimis, MMRRAW.CONCURRENT_ENROLL AS DualPrtDEnrollSts, MMRRAW.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AS PBP, MMRRAW.RACE_CODE AS RaceCode, MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_CD AS RiskAdjFacTypeCode, MMRRAW.FRAILTY_IND AS FrailtyInd, MMRRAW.OREC AS OREC, MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_CD  AS LagInd, MMRRAW.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_SGMNT_ID AS SegmentNumber, MMRRAW.ENROLL_SRC  AS EnrollmentSource, MMRRAW.EGHP_FLAG AS EGHPFlag, MMRRAW.BASIC_PART_C_PART_A AS PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt, MMRRAW.BASIC_PART_C_PART_B AS PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_A AS RbtPrtACostSharReduc, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_CS_RED_PART_B AS RbtPrtBCostSharReduc, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_A AS RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_MSB_PART_B AS RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_A AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_PART_B_RED_PART_B AS RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_A AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt, MMRRAW.MA_REBATE_PART_D_SB_PART_B AS RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt, MMRRAW.TOTAL_MA_PART_A AS TotalPrtAMAPymt, MMRRAW.TOTAL_MA_PART_B AS TotalPrtBMAPymt, MMRRAW.ORIG_MDRNZN_ACT_TOTL_PAY_AMT AS TotalMAPayAmt, MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_FAC_PART_D AS PrtDRAFac, MMRRAW.LOW_INCOME_MI_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeInd, MMRRAW.LOW_INCOME_M_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeMul, MMRRAW.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_PART_D AS PrtDLongTermInstInd, MMRRAW.LT_INSTITUTIONAL_M_PART_D AS PrtDLongTermInstMul, MMRRAW.ORIG_PART_D_PREM_RDCTN_AMT AS RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc, MMRRAW.BASIC_PREM_RED_PART_D AS PrtDBasicPremAmt, MMRRAW.ORIG_PART_D_DRCT_SBSDY_AMT AS PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt, MMRRAW.ORIG_REINSRNC_SBSDY_AMT AS ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt, MMRRAW.ORIG_LOW_INCM_COST_SHRG_AMT AS LICSSubsidyAmt, MMRRAW.TOTAL_PART_D_PAY AS TotalPrtDPymt, MMRRAW.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_MON_PART_D AS NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD, MMRRAW.PACE_PREM_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D AS PACEPremAddOn, MMRRAW.PACE_CS_ADD_ON_AMT_PART_D AS PACECostSharingAddon, MMRRAW.FRAILTY_FAC_PART_C AS PrtCFrailtyScoreFac, MMRRAW.MSP_RED_FAC_PART_C AS MSPFac, MMRRAW.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_A AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA, MMRRAW.MSP_RED_AMT_PART_B AS MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB, MMRRAW.MEDICAID_DUAL_STS_CD AS MedicaidDualStsCode, MMRRAW.ORIG_PART_D_CVRG_GAP_DSCNT_AMT AS PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt, MMRRAW.RISK_ADJ_FAC_TYPE_PART_D AS PrtDRiskAdjtFacType, MMRRAW.DEF_RISK_FAC_CD_PART_D AS DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode, MMRRAW.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_A AS PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt, MMRRAW.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_B AS PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt, MMRRAW.MONTHLY_RATE_PART_D AS PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt, MMRRAW.CLEANUP_ID AS CleanupID, NH.SBSB_ID AS SBSB_ID FROM  PSGL.CMS_MMR_RAW MMRRAW JOIN PSGL.MMR_NH_LOAD NH  ON NH.MEME_HICN = MMRRAW.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AND NH.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = MMRRAW.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR  AND NH.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID = MMRRAW.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AND MMRRAW.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT AND MMRRAW.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBSQL
SRCOLEDBSQL derive({Copy of PrtCFrailtyScoreFac} = toString(PrtCFrailtyScoreFac),
		{Copy of NewMedicaidStsflag} = toString(NewMedicaidStsflag),
		PrtDLowIncomeInd_DC = toString(PrtDLowIncomeInd),
		{Copy of RiskAdjFacTypeCode} = toString(RiskAdjFacTypeCode),
		{Copy of PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt} = toString(PrtDDirectSubsidyMonthlyPayAmt),
		{Copy of PrtDRiskAdjtFacType} = toString(PrtDRiskAdjtFacType),
		{Copy of PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt} = toString(PrtDCoveGapDiscAmt),
		{Copy of MonPayAdjAmtRateB} = toString(MonPayAdjAmtRateB),
		{Copy of RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits} = toString(RbtPrtAManSuppBenefits),
		{Copy of PrtAEntitlement} = toString(PrtAEntitlement),
		{Copy of PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt} = toString(PrtARiskAdjAmoforPymt),
		RiskAdjFacPrtB_DC = toString(RiskAdjFacPrtB),
		{Copy of RiskAdjAgeGroup} = toString(RiskAdjAgeGroup),
		{Copy of Surname} = toString(Surname),
		{Copy of PrtBEntitlement} = toString(PrtBEntitlement),
		PaymentDate_DC = toString(PaymentDate),
		{Copy of MedicaidSts} = toString(MedicaidSts),
		{Copy of RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits} = toString(RbtPrtBManSuppBenefits),
		{Copy of NHC} = toString(NHC),
		{Copy of NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB} = toString(NoofPayAdjMonthPrtB),
		{Copy of TotalPrtAMAPymt} = toString(TotalPrtAMAPymt),
		{Copy of RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt} = toString(RbtPrtBPremReducPrtBAmt),
		{Copy ContractNumber} = toString(ContractNumber),
		{Copy of Filler} = toString(Filler),
		PrtDRAFac_DC = toString(PrtDRAFac),
		{Copy of MSPFac} = toString(MSPFac),
		{Copy of PrtDBasicPremAmt} = toString(PrtDBasicPremAmt),
		Hospice_DC = toString(Hospice),
		{Copy of DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode} = toString(DefaultPrtDRiskAdjtFacCode),
		SBSB_ID_DC = toString(SBSB_ID),
		{Copy of LTIFlag} = toString(LTIFlag),
		{Copy of PrtDLongTermInstMul} = toString(PrtDLongTermInstMul),
		{Copy of FirstInitial} = toString(FirstInitial),
		{Copy of PrtDLongTermInstInd} = toString(PrtDLongTermInstInd),
		{Copy of PIP_DCG} = toString(PIP_DCG),
		NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD_DC = toString(NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD),
		{Copy of RaceCode} = toString(RaceCode),
		{Copy of RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt} = toString(RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtAAmt),
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA_DC = toString(NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA),
		{Copy of EGHPFlag} = toString(EGHPFlag),
		PayAdjStartDate_DC = toDate(toString(PayAdjStartDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of DateofBirth} = DateofBirth,
		AgeGroup_DC = toString(AgeGroup),
		{Copy of PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt} = toString(PrtDDirSubsidyAmtforPymt),
		{Copy of PACEPremAddOn} = toString(PACEPremAddOn),
		{Copy of HICN} = toString(HICN),
		{Copy of PBP} = toString(PBP),
		GenderCode_DC = toString(GenderCode),
		{Copy of TotalMAPayAmt} = toString(TotalMAPayAmt),
		StateCountyCode_DC = toString(StateCountyCode),
		{Copy of CleanupID} = toString(CleanupID),
		{Copy of MonPayAdjAmtRateA} = toString(MonPayAdjAmtRateA),
		{Copy of PreviousDisableRatio} = toString(PreviousDisableRatio),
		{Copy of LagInd} = toString(LagInd),
		{Copy of DemPayAdjRatePrtA} = toString(DemPayAdjRatePrtA),
		{Copy of RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt} = toString(RbtPrtBPremReducPrtAAmt),
		{Copy of OutofAreaInd} = toString(OutofAreaInd),
		PayAdjEndDate_DC = toDate(toString(PayAdjEndDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of PACECostSharingAddon} = toString(PACECostSharingAddon),
		{Copy of ESRDMSPFlag} = toString(ESRDMSPFlag),
		Inst_DC = toString(Inst),
		{Copy of RbtPrtACostSharReduc} = toString(RbtPrtACostSharReduc),
		{Copy of RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt} = toString(RbtPrtDSuppBenefitPrtBAmt),
		{Copy of TotalPrtDPymt} = toString(TotalPrtDPymt),
		{Copy of MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB} = toString(MSPReducAdjAmtPrtB),
		{Copy of FrailtyInd} = toString(FrailtyInd),
		{Copy of OREC} = toString(OREC),
		{Copy of MedicaidInd} = toString(MedicaidInd),
		{Copy of SegmentNumber} = toString(SegmentNumber),
		{Copy of ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt} = toString(ReinsuranceSubsidyAmt),
		{Copy of DemPayAdjRatePrtB} = toString(DemPayAdjRatePrtB),
		{Copy of PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt} = toString(PrtCBasicPremPrtAAmt),
		{Copy of MedicaidDualStsCode} = toString(MedicaidDualStsCode),
		{Copy of PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt} = toString(PrtCBasicPremPrtBAmt),
		{Copy of DefaultRiskFacCode} = toString(DefaultRiskFacCode),
		{Copy of RbtPrtBCostSharReduc} = toString(RbtPrtBCostSharReduc),
		ESRD_DC = toString(ESRD),
		RiskAdjFacPrtA_DC = toString(RiskAdjFacPrtA),
		{Copy of DeMinimis} = toString(DeMinimis),
		AdjReasonCode_DC = toString(AdjReasonCode),
		{Copy of PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt} = toString(PrtBRiskAdjAmoforPymt),
		{Copy of MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA} = toString(MSPReducAdjAmtPrtA),
		{Copy of EnrollmentSource} = toString(EnrollmentSource),
		{Copy of DualPrtDEnrollSts} = toString(DualPrtDEnrollSts),
		{Copy of AgedDisabledMSP} = toString(AgedDisabledMSP),
		{Copy of PrtDLowIncomeMul} = toString(PrtDLowIncomeMul),
		{Copy of TotalPrtBMAPymt} = toString(TotalPrtBMAPymt),
		{Copy of MTM} = toString(MTM),
		{Copy of LISPremSubsidy} = toString(LISPremSubsidy),
		{Copy of RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc} = toString(RbtPrtDBasicPremReduc),
		{Copy of LICSSubsidyAmt} = toString(LICSSubsidyAmt)) ~> DCNVCOMBINEDATA
